Context: Eligibility:

10. NOTE 1.Only one withdrawal can be allowed for the same purpose. Marriage or education of different children or illness on different occasions or a further addition / alteration to a house/ flat covered by a fresh plan , these are treated as for different purposes. - Note 7, Rule 15 (1).  
NOTE 2.-  
Betrothal and Marriage are treated as separate purposes.  
- GID (2), Rule 16.
